_note: Licensing or registration bodies by country. Compiled for the demo and NOT yet verified against official sources.

medical-doctor.UG: Uganda Medical and Dental Practitioners Council
medical-doctor.KE: Kenya Medical Practitioners and Dentists Council
medical-doctor.NG: Medical and Dental Council of Nigeria
medical-doctor.ZA: Health Professions Council of South Africa
medical-doctor.US: State medical board (after the USMLE exams)

dentist.UG: Uganda Medical and Dental Practitioners Council
dentist.KE: Kenya Medical Practitioners and Dentists Council
dentist.NG: Medical and Dental Council of Nigeria
dentist.ZA: Health Professions Council of South Africa

nurse.NG: Nursing and Midwifery Council of Nigeria
nurse.GH: Nursing and Midwifery Council of Ghana
nurse.US: State board of nursing (after the NCLEX exam)

midwife.NG: Nursing and Midwifery Council of Nigeria
midwife.GH: Nursing and Midwifery Council of Ghana

pharmacist.US: State board of pharmacy (after the NAPLEX exam)

civil-engineer.NG: Council for the Regulation of Engineering in Nigeria (COREN)

mechanical-engineer.NG: Council for the Regulation of Engineering in Nigeria (COREN)

electrical-engineer.NG: Council for the Regulation of Engineering in Nigeria (COREN)

lawyer.UG: Law Development Centre bar course, then enrolment as an advocate
lawyer.KE: Kenya School of Law, then admission to the Roll of Advocates
lawyer.NG: Nigerian Law School, then call to the Bar
lawyer.GH: Ghana School of Law, then call to the Bar
lawyer.GB: Solicitors Regulation Authority (SQE) or Bar Standards Board

accountant.UG: Institute of Certified Public Accountants of Uganda (ICPAU)
accountant.KE: Institute of Certified Public Accountants of Kenya (ICPAK)
accountant.NG: Institute of Chartered Accountants of Nigeria (ICAN)
accountant.ZA: South African Institute of Chartered Accountants (SAICA)
accountant.GB: Professional bodies such as ICAEW or ACCA

architect.KE: Board of Registration of Architects and Quantity Surveyors
architect.ZA: South African Council for the Architectural Profession
